title: That Wobbly Tape Measure Hook Is Not Broken
hook: The most familiar tool in the drawer has a part everyone thinks is broken.

cast.note: Bill is a person mildly betrayed by an object, then quietly impressed by it.

scenes.note: The wobble is the hook of the episode. Show it moving before anyone explains it.

beats.action: Bill holds a tape measure; the end hook visibly rattles as he shakes it
camera punches onto the hook; it slides back and forth on its rivets
Bill turns the tape over, frowning at it
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a WORN OUT? label lands beside the hook, then gets crossed out

scenes.note: Clean measurement diagram. The travel distance and the hook thickness are drawn as the SAME dimension.

beats.action: the hook isolates on a schematic field, drawn in section
the hook travels its full play; a dimension line measures the travel
a second dimension line measures the metal thickness — the two are identical and snap together

scenes.note: Outside measurement. The hook pulls OUT and the gap it leaves is exactly its own thickness.

beats.action: a board edge appears; the tape hooks over it
the hook slides outward against the board; the tape body moves back by the hook thickness
the added thickness highlights teal against the ruler scale

scenes.note: Inside measurement — the mirror of the previous scene. Same hook, opposite direction.

beats.action: the board becomes an inside corner; the tape pushes against it
the hook compresses flat against the wall, sliding inward
the same thickness highlights coral and is subtracted from the scale
the hook face presses flat against the corner and holds there
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Both diagrams collapse into one reading. Sincere, not smug. Hard cut on the last word.

beats.action: both measurements resolve to the same TRUE ZERO mark; the two diagrams overlay perfectly
Bill wiggles the hook once more, now approvingly
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: Bill clips the tape back on his belt; hard cut
the dimension lines from both diagrams slide together and align
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap
